name: paper2011
source:
theorem paper2011 : Paper2011 := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := upper2026 1 (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨1/128,61/2+1,by norm_num,by norm_num,max 16 N,?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact ⟨by simpa only [one_div,div_eq_inv_mul,mul_one] using lower2011 n ((le_max_left ..).trans hn),
    hN n ((le_max_right ..).trans hn)⟩

name: paper2026
source:
theorem paper2026 : Paper2026 := by
  intro ε he
  obtain ⟨A,ha⟩ := sharp_lower ε he
  obtain ⟨B,hb⟩ := upper2026 ε he
  exact ⟨max A B,fun n hn => ⟨ha n (le_max_left A B |>.trans hn),hb n (le_max_right A B |>.trans hn)⟩⟩

statement.name: Paper2026

name: every_even_cube
source:
theorem every_even_cube (g : cubeGroup) (even : EvenCube g) :
    ∃ A B : cubeGroup, FullCycles A ∧ FullCycles B ∧ orderOf A = 24 ∧ orderOf B = 24 ∧
      A * B * A⁻¹ * B⁻¹ = g := by
  obtain ⟨s, legal, target, sign⟩ := even
  obtain ⟨ca, cb, cornersEq⟩ := corners s.cp s.twists sign legal.2.1
  obtain ⟨ea, eb, edgesEq⟩ := edges s.ep s.flips (legal.1.symm.trans sign) legal.2.2
  refine ⟨pairFactors ca ea, pairFactors cb eb, pair_full .., pair_full ..,
    pair_order .., pair_order .., Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  exact (Prod.ext cornersEq edgesEq : _ = s.action).trans target
